reason: The hypothesis synthesizes the observation of local chemical fluctuations and their effect on SFE from P1/P25 with the concept of local chemical order roughening dislocation pathways from P7/P27, and applies this combined mechanism to explain property differences across the entire Cantor alloy family (quinary to ternary subsets). No single passage proposes this specific integration to predict a systematic trend in deformation mechanisms with constituent count, nor does any passage design a controlled experiment across the full subset series.
